methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing was collected from each vendor's official pricing page on the access date. monthlyUsd records the month-to-month rate; where only annual billing is published, the annualized monthly rate is used and the month-to-month rate noted. annualDiscountPct is set only when both monthly and annual rates are explicitly stated or when a precise discount figure is published. Quote-only / contact-sales tiers carry monthlyUsd null. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall are null on every plan (non-telephony vertical). hipaa and baa are true/false only when explicitly stated on the pricing page; else null. Corroboration sources are independent third-party review/comparison pages accessed on the same date.

vendors.name: Circle
vendors.provenance: https://circle.so/pricing (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-14). No annual billing toggle displayed; only monthly rates shown. 14-day free trial, no credit card required. 30-day money-back guarantee.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Unlimited members, courses, discussions, events, website builder, live streams, custom branding, analytics, paid memberships, gamification. 2% transaction fee. No annual billing option shown on pricing page.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Everything in Professional plus workflows, custom profile fields, APIs, branded email notifications, automated transcriptions, activity scores. 1% transaction fee.

plans.name: Circle Plus
plans.notes: Quote-only. Everything in Business plus AI Agents, custom SSO, higher limits, 10k Email Hub contacts included, 0.5% transaction fee, dedicated success manager, concierge onboarding, optional branded mobile apps.

vendors.name: Mighty Networks
vendors.provenance: https://www.mightynetworks.com/pricing (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-14). Annual billing offers '2 months free' (~16.7% discount); Launch annual total is $950/year ($79.17/mo). Scale annual total not published explicitly; estimated ~$1,490/year based on 2-months-free pattern but not shown as dollar amount on page — annualDiscountPct set to 17 for both based on stated '2 months free'. 14-day free trial, no credit card required. SOC2 Type II certified.

plans.name: Launch
plans.notes: Annual billing: $950/year (~$79/mo, 2 months free ≈17% discount). Unlimited members; courses, events, badges, gamification, basic automations, 200GB storage, 3 hosts/10 moderators, 20 streaming hours/month. 2% transaction fee.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: Annual billing: '2 months free' (~17% discount); exact annual dollar total not displayed on page. Unlimited members; more integrations, automated polls, Kit integration, 500GB storage, 5 hosts/15 moderators, 30 streaming hours/month, limited API access. 1% transaction fee.

plans.name: Mighty Pro
plans.notes: Quote-only. Custom branded apps, dedicated strategy team, account management, 4TB storage, unlimited hosts/moderators, 50 streaming hours/month, advanced automations, enhanced gamification, member video upload. 0.5% transaction fee.

vendors.name: Skool
vendors.provenance: https://www.skool.com/pricing (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-14). Annual billing promoted as '2 months free' but exact annual dollar amounts are not published on the page; annualDiscountPct set to 17 based on the stated '2 months free' (10/12 months paid). Free trial available.

plans.name: Hobby
plans.notes: Annual billing: '2 months free' (~17% discount; implied ~$90/year). Unlimited members, courses, videos, live calls, custom URL, affiliates program. 10% transaction fee on paid memberships.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Annual billing: '2 months free' (~17% discount; implied ~$990/year). Unlimited members, courses, videos, live calls, custom URL, affiliates program. 2.9% transaction fee on paid memberships.

vendors.name: Discourse
vendors.provenance: https://www.discourse.org/pricing (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-14). No annual billing discount stated on page. GDPR & CCPA compliant hosting on Enterprise. No annual discount advertised.

plans.name: Free

plans.name: Pro

plans.name: Enterprise

vendors.provenance: https://www.heartbeat.chat/pricing (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-14). Annual billing prices are explicitly published. 14-day free trial, no credit card required.

plans.name: Scale
